blocks.text: BRUSSELS, Belgium—The European Union wants to beef up its border agency with powers to handle deportations under plans to strengthen the bloc’s response to irregular migration presented on Tuesday. The European Commission proposed giving the Frontex agency a central role in arranging the expulsion of people with no right to stay in the EU. It also wants to create a 17,000-strong “reserve” of officers ready to be deployed when needed. “Europe will always stand up for the protection of its borders. Europe decides who comes to our Union and under what circumstances,” EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said. The reform plan […]...
